hypotheses.N1_raw_top4_tracks_natural_write: At every layer raw top-four directions capture at least half as much centered natural-write variance as the optimal natural top-four space.
hypotheses.N2_middle_leading_spike_is_used: The raw leading Layer-5 direction captures at least 25% of the optimal natural rank-one variance.
hypotheses.N3_late_raw4_is_behaviorally_compact: Keeping only the raw Layer-11 top-four write directions gives median final-distribution KL at most 0.02.
hypotheses.N4_raw4_beats_random_behaviorally: At every layer raw top-four retention gives lower median KL than a fixed random four-space.
hypotheses.N5_covariance_cleaning_shortens_forms: At every layer median covariance-cleaned rank-four score correlation exceeds raw rank-four correlation by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.N6_cleaned_forms_predict_heldout_scores: At every layer median covariance-cleaned rank-four held-out score correlation is at least 0.90.
hypotheses.N7_full_projection_identity: Full output-space projection changes final distributions by median KL at most 1e-7 at every layer.
